items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Isaiah directly; the name appears only in the interviewer's narration ('Him, his brother Isaiah carried the band over there') and later in the interviewer's summary of who came to learn music ('Isaiah, Morgan, they come...'). The interviewee's responses focus on Sam,

ctx.x: I carried him over there. Him, his brother Isaiah carried the band over there. Not Yank.
You're talking about Sam. I mean... Well I'm talking about Yank was playing the trombone with him. Oh yeah.
